benefits.title: Why creators choose us
benefits.subtitle: Structured account, traffic, and chat management — no chaos and no “easy money” hype. Here is what every creator gets at OFM.

items.title: Dedicated manager
items.desc: You get one personal manager — a single point of contact for strategy, content, and payouts. They know your account and drive it toward goals instead of bouncing tasks between departments.
highlights: Daily Telegram contact, seven days a week
Content plan, pricing, and promo alignment
Support with fan disputes and platform issues

items.title: Strong marketing
items.desc: Our team builds the funnel from first click to subscription and PPV purchase. We test creatives, audiences, and sources to scale what actually converts.
highlights: Reddit, Twitter/X, TikTok, partners, and paid traffic
A/B tests for covers, bio, and offers
Weekly analytics by subscription source

items.title: Real results
items.desc: With consistent work, average creator income is $12,000 to $35,000+ per month. Growth is staged: stable base first, then PPV scale and top-fan retention.
highlights: Clear reports on subs, chats, and PPV
Focus on fan LTV, not one-off sales
Case studies from zero to stable income

items.title: Full confidentiality
items.desc: Anonymity and safety are the foundation of an OnlyFans business. We help separate identity from brand, set up processes, and respond fast to leaks and doxxing.
highlights: Guidance on VPN, geo, and payment data
Legal support for DMCA and copyright
Leak monitoring and rapid takedowns

items.title: Tailored approach
items.desc: No copy-paste playbook: strategy fits your look, niche, audience language, and schedule. GFE, fetish, fitness — positioning and content adapt to you.
highlights: Profile and competitor audit before launch
Custom pricing and service menu
Strategy reviews every 2–4 weeks

items.title: Fast launch
items.desc: From approved application to first payouts is usually 7–14 days. Profile, content, and traffic are set up in parallel so prep weeks do not mean zero revenue.
highlights: Launch checklist and bio / pinned post templates
Team prepares first posts and mass messages
Chat onboarding and fan communication rules

how.title: How we work
how.subtitle: A clear path from application to stable income — no surprises and no endless “calls for the sake of calls.” Every stage is defined upfront.
how.footerNote: Average time from approval to launch — 7–14 days. First manager reply — within 24 hours.

steps.title: Application
steps.desc: You complete a short form on the site: name, Telegram, age, and a few questions about experience. No ten-page resume — only what we need for an initial decision.
highlights: Works fully on mobile
Data sent over a secure connection
Confirmation in Telegram after submit

steps.title: Initial review
steps.desc: The team reviews your profile, niche, and monetization potential. If it’s a fit — we message you on Telegram and schedule a call. If not — we explain why honestly, without leaving you hanging.
highlights: Review of look, niche, and content readiness
Platform rules check (18+)
Clear answer: yes / no / what to improve

steps.title: Intro call
steps.desc: Video or voice on Telegram: we meet, discuss income expectations, schedule, anonymity, and content format. You ask questions — we show how work runs at OFM.
highlights: Terms, rev share, and collaboration model
Boundaries and content taboos
Answers on chats, marketing, and payouts

steps.title: Strategy
steps.desc: We build a roadmap: positioning, pricing, first-month content plan, traffic sources, and KPIs. You approve the plan before launch — not a silent “we’ll do what we know.”
highlights: Plan for posts, PPV, mass messages, promos
Pricing tailored to niche and audience
Launch calendar and team owners

steps.title: Setup & launch
steps.desc: In parallel we set up OnlyFans, visuals, chat managers, and first ad setups. Goal: go live with a ready funnel, not an empty profile and hope.
highlights: Bio, header, pinned posts
First content pack and test mass messages
Traffic starts on launch day or the next

steps.title: Growth & support
steps.desc: After launch — weekly reports, metric reviews, and strategy tweaks. Your manager and marketing scale what works; chats drive LTV and PPV sales.
highlights: Reports on subs, chats, PPV, and traffic
Regular calls or Telegram updates
Scale ads and content based on numbers
